components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The default and emphasis action — solid green, full width.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display:block; width:100%; padding:15px; border:1px solid transparent; border-radius:10px; font-family:Inter,system-ui,sans-serif; font-size:.95rem; font-weight:600; letter-spacing:-.01em; cursor:pointer; background:#0a7d54; color:#fff; box-shadow:0 1px 2px rgba(10,125,84,.25),0 6px 16px rgba(10,125,84,.18); transition:background .2s ease, box-shadow .2s ease, transform .1s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background:#096b48; transform:translateY(-1px); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform:scale(.985); }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Lower-emphasis action — white fill, neutral border, green text.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display:block; width:100%; padding:15px; border:1px solid #dfe3e8; border-radius:10px; font-family:Inter,system-ui,sans-serif; font-size:.95rem; font-weight:600; letter-spacing:-.01em; cursor:pointer; background:#fff; color:#096b48; transition:border-color .2s ease, background .2s ease; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { border-color:#0a7d54; background:#e7f3ee; }

components.name: Card
components.description: The white surface that holds a step's content.
components.html:
Review Extracted Data

Check the scores the AI read from your photo.
components.css: .ds-card { background:#fff; border:1px solid #e8ebef; border-radius:14px; box-shadow:0 1px 2px rgba(20,24,28,.04),0 2px 8px rgba(20,24,28,.05); padding:24px; color:#14181c; } .ds-card h2 { font-family:Inter,system-ui,sans-serif; font-size:1.15rem; font-weight:700; color:#14181c; margin:0 0 16px; padding-bottom:12px; border-bottom:1px solid #e8ebef; letter-spacing:-.01em; } .ds-card p { font-family:Inter,system-ui,sans-serif; font-size:.95rem; line-height:1.55; color:#5f6b78; margin:0; }

components.name: Score Box
components.description: Large hole-numbered score input; tabular figures.
components.css: .ds-hole-cell { display:inline-flex; flex-direction:column; align-items:center; gap:3px; } .ds-hole-cell .ds-hole-no { font-size:.66rem; font-weight:700; color:#4a5560; } .ds-hole-cell input { width:58px; height:46px; text-align:center; font-size:1.05rem; font-weight:600; font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums; font-family:Inter,system-ui,sans-serif; border:1px solid #dfe3e8; border-radius:7px; background:#fff; color:#14181c; } .ds-hole-cell input:focus { outline:none; border-color:#0a7d54; box-shadow:0 0 6px rgba(10,125,84,.2); }

components.name: Game Row
components.description: Game-picker row: icon well, name, description, sliding chevron. No side-stripe.
components.css: .ds-game-btn { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:15px; width:100%; padding:16px 18px; background:#fff; border:1px solid #dfe3e8; border-radius:10px; cursor:pointer; text-align:left; color:#14181c; box-shadow:0 1px 2px rgba(20,24,28,.04),0 2px 8px rgba(20,24,28,.05); transition:border-color .2s ease, box-shadow .2s ease, transform .2s ease; } .ds-game-btn:hover { border-color:#0a7d54; box-shadow:0 4px 16px rgba(20,24,28,.08),0 12px 28px rgba(20,24,28,.06); transform:translateY(-1px); } .ds-game-icon { width:44px; height:44px; border-radius:12px; background:#e7f3ee; border:1px solid transparent; display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; font-size:1.25rem; flex-shrink:0; } .ds-game-btn:hover .ds-game-icon { border-color:#0a7d54; } .ds-game-info { display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:3px; flex:1; } .ds-game-name { font-family:Inter,system-ui,sans-serif; font-size:1.02rem; font-weight:700; color:#14181c; letter-spacing:-.01em; } .ds-game-desc { font-family:Inter,system-ui,sans-serif; font-size:.8rem; color:#5f6b78; line-height:1.5; } .ds-game-chevron { color:#5f6b78; font-size:1.3rem; flex-shrink:0; transition:all .2s; } .ds-game-btn:hover .ds-game-chevron { color:#0a7d54; transform:translateX(3px); }

components.name: Winner Banner
components.description: The payoff — green gradient plaque, heavy sans winner name. The one saturated moment.
components.css: .ds-win-banner { background:linear-gradient(135deg,#12a06d 0%,#096b48 100%); border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.14); border-radius:14px; padding:26px 24px; text-align:center; color:#fff; box-shadow:0 8px 30px rgba(10,125,84,.28); } .ds-win-name { font-family:Inter,system-ui,sans-serif; font-size:1.5rem; font-weight:800; letter-spacing:-.02em; margin-bottom:6px; } .ds-win-detail { font-family:Inter,system-ui,sans-serif; font-size:.85rem; color:rgba(255,255,255,.85); }

components.name: Result Badges
components.description: Green for gross wins, slate for net wins, inert for none.
components.html: Sam Ann –
components.css: .ds-badge { display:inline-block; padding:3px 10px; border-radius:20px; font-family:Inter,system-ui,sans-serif; font-size:.68rem; font-weight:700; letter-spacing:.01em; } .ds-badge-gross { background:#e7f3ee; color:#096b48; } .ds-badge-net { background:#eef1f4; color:#3f4b57; } .ds-badge-none { background:#eaedf1; color:#5f6b78; }

components.name: Toggle
components.description: Pill switch that slides to green when on.
components.css: .ds-toggle { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:10px; cursor:pointer; user-select:none; } .ds-toggle input { position:absolute; opacity:0; width:0; height:0; } .ds-toggle-slider { position:relative; width:40px; height:22px; background:#dfe3e8; border-radius:22px; transition:background .25s ease; flex-shrink:0; } .ds-toggle-slider::after { content:''; position:absolute; top:2px; left:2px; width:18px; height:18px; background:#fff; border-radius:50%; box-shadow:0 1px 3px rgba(0,0,0,.15); transition:transform .25s ease; } .ds-toggle input:checked ~ .ds-toggle-slider { background:#0a7d54; } .ds-toggle input:checked ~ .ds-toggle-slider::after { transform:translateX(18px); } .ds-toggle-text { font-family:Inter,system-ui,sans-serif; font-size:.88rem; font-weight:600; color:#4a5560; }

narrative.overview: A premium sports/finance app that happens to score golf bets — the feel of Apple Sports or a Stripe receipt, not a country-club interior. Surfaces are near-white, text is near-black ink, and a single restrained green is the only real color: primary action, current step, and wins. One typeface (Inter) in a range of weights, with tabular figures so scores line up like a scoreboard. Calm, fast, authoritative — it earns trust through legibility and restraint, not decoration, because the organizer is settling money on a phone in bright sun. It rejects the free-scorecard-app look, the SaaS dashboard, the cluttered spreadsheet, and its own former ornate Augusta/gold/serif self.
keyCharacteristics: Near-white surfaces on a light neutral field; near-black ink
One green accent, held to ~10% of any screen
One sans (Inter), all weights, tabular numerals for all data
Flat and quiet at rest; the winner banner is the single saturated moment
Phone-first, one-column, generously sized for arm's-length reading

rules.name: The Green-Is-The-Ruling Rule
rules.body: Green is reserved for the primary action, the current step, and a win. Never a page or card background, never decoration. Its scarcity is what makes a green cue read as 'this is the answer.'

rules.name: The Gross-Green / Net-Slate Rule
rules.body: Gross results tint green; net results tint slate. The only place a second color enters the data layer, so the two scoring categories are never confused at a glance.

rules.name: The Tabular-Figures Rule
rules.body: All numerals are tabular so scores, points and totals align in columns like a scoreboard. Proportional figures in a score grid are prohibited.

rules.name: The One-Voice Rule
rules.body: One typeface (Inter), differentiated by weight. No serif, no display face, no second family anywhere.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest. Elevation is a response to interaction or importance (the winner banner), never ambient decoration.

dos: Do keep green to ~10% of any screen: primary action, current step, and wins only.
Do tint gross results green and net results slate.
Do set every numeral in tabular figures so scores align.
Do use one typeface (Inter) across the whole app, differentiated by weight.
Do keep surfaces white on the #f6f7f9 field, with near-black #14181c ink.
Do keep it one-column and phone-first, with large tap targets.
donts: Don't reintroduce the retired Augusta costume: no gold, no leather-grain texture, no Cormorant serif, no rainbow header stripe.
Don't use a colored side-stripe (border-left > 1px) on cards, banners, or panels.
Don't make it look like a 'free scorecard app' — no cartoon mascots, clip-art, or novelty fonts.
Don't drift toward a generic SaaS dashboard — no cold blue-and-gray chrome.
Don't present results as a cluttered spreadsheet — big labeled cells, not tiny gridlined numbers.
Don't use pure white pages or pure black text, and don't let green become a background flood.
